rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Beauty from Within
rows.Origin:
Bred by Estabissements Horticoles Orard (France, before 2002).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2002 as 'Beauty from Within'.
rows.Bloom: Deep golden center with pink edges on the outer petals, takes on an orange hue as it opens. None / no fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), cupped, high-centered bloom form.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
